news.title: Mechanic: hands-on work and shop fixes
news.summary: Hold left click to spray while walking around the car. Short wheel, part and engine jobs keep the props and skip the drawn-out minigames.
news.body: Hold left click to spray while walking around four broad sides of the car; release to pause. Prep and clear coat are automatic. Wheel and brake jobs use one progress bar per corner with changing text, tools and removed-wheel props. Parts use short E actions; engine swaps have a few quick steps with a hoist and visible engine. Normal camera stays under your control. Scanner access is at the door, hood work is at the front and the hood closes afterward. Lift controls are on the post control box. Shops now have guided paint-booth zones and an E menu for active paint orders, tablet-only management, clearer job panels, character-name logs and custom-engine dyno labels. Test all of this, cancellation, stock/payment accuracy and two-player lift movement in the server testing panel.

news.title: Recovery: smoother bed and winch movement
news.body: Flatbed and winch movement now use shared timing. Test loading, unloading and raising/lowering with a second player watching, including different FPS and streaming in midway. Report any snapping or drift in the testing panel.

news.title: Player experience: phone, emotes and voice
news.body: Phone alerts and unread badges, weapon holstering, call/radio effects, animation recovery and saved walk styles/expressions received fixes. Check them with a friend and after reconnecting. Also verify impound status and waypoints in the Garage app.

news.title: Death and flood recovery
news.body: Death blackout now waits 800 ms. Test death, revive and respawn timing. During staff-run flood tests, check swimming, returning to normal movement and water rendering.

news.title: Character selection: matching panel tilt
news.body: YOUR NEXT CHAPTER now follows the resident panel tilt. Check readability and character controls at your resolution.

news.title: Server testing and launcher news
news.body: Use the server testing panel to record what works, failures and clips. These updates need real in-game testing after the server pulls main and restarts. News refreshes when you reopen the launcher; no reinstall for future news edits. Launcher 1.0.5 adds expandable news cards.
